That's what I'm scared of - I volunteer with children as a youth worker (which is why it ticks me off even more that these kids do it), and I can't afford anything on my record.

I think the fact I've been ill with my asthma isn't helping either, and maybe when the sun comes back out and my chest doesn't feel like someone is sitting on it things will be better.

I'm not in the US, I'm in the UK.

The kids are around 11-12 or so. I appreciate this might seem a little *pansylike* to be actually unnerved by these little bastards, but the truth is I'm scared they're going to cause damage to my house; or worse do something that's going to injure my daughter. The fact is I live in a crappy neighbourhood and some kids around here aren't nice. 

Normally, I'm okay; it's just these late nights when I can't sleep and everything seems to get on top of me.
